CELA – Clean Energy Latin America, for 12 years, has been providing financial and strategic advice to companies and investors in the renewable energy and energy transition sector in Latin America.

Domain of corporate finance, accounting, financial modeling, project finance, valuation;

Minimum experience of 3 years in project modeling and valuation;
4.Fluent English;

Main responsibilities:

Building complex financial models for existing demands and for new technologies in the energy sector;
2.
Valuation, due diligence and feasibility analysis of projects;
3.
Modeling and analysis of optimal capital structure, fundraising via project finance and/or corporate finance, as well as detailed analysis of cost of capital and returns;

Construction and detailed evaluation of sensitivities and scenarios;

Assist the other areas related to CELA's consulting and M&A in the creation of financial modeling and analysis tools when necessary.

Remuneration compatible with the market.

Health insurance;

Mostly home office regime, with the possibility of participating in face-to-face meetings in São Paulo and other locations when necessary.

Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 26 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora.

  • Ser capaz de se relacionar com as áreas internas da Segurpro para ajudar no processo de desenho de modelo operacional que vá conseguir aumentar as vendas de Global Risk;

Job description

Estamos em busca de um Mecânico de Linha Amarela para se juntar à nossa equipe. O candidato ideal deve possuir habilidades técnicas avançadas e um forte comprometimento com a manutenção e reparo de equipamentos pesados, garantindo a eficiência e a segurança nas operações.


Main responsibilities

Lubrificação Especializada: Realizar a lubrificação precisa e regular de equipamentos de linha amarela, seguindo as especificações do fabricante para garantir a operação eficiente e a longevidade das máquinas.

Inspeção de Equipamentos: Inspecionar e avaliar o estado dos equipamentos, identificando pontos críticos de lubrificação e verificando níveis de óleo e outros fluidos essenciais.

Aplicação de Lubrificantes: Aplicar lubrificantes e outros fluidos de forma eficaz e uniforme em sistemas hidráulicos, motores e componentes das máquinas, utilizando técnicas e ferramentas apropriadas.

Manutenção Preventiva: Executar tarefas de manutenção preventiva relacionadas à lubrificação, garantindo que as máquinas operem dentro das melhores condições possíveis e prevenindo falhas.

Documentação e Relatórios: Manter registros detalhados das atividades de lubrificação, incluindo tipos e quantidades de lubrificante utilizados. Preparar relatórios sobre o estado dos equipamentos e quaisquer necessidades de manutenção adicionais.

Segurança e Procedimentos: Seguir rigorosamente os procedimentos de segurança, incluindo o uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPI) e práticas seguras de manuseio de lubrificantes e produtos químicos.

Colaboração e Comunicação: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com mecânicos e operadores de máquinas para garantir que as necessidades de manutenção sejam atendidas e comunicar quaisquer problemas ou recomendações.


Requirements and skills

Experiência: Experiência comprovada em lubrificação de equipamentos pesados, com foco em máquinas de linha amarela (escavadeiras, retroescavadeiras, tratores, etc.)

Curso: Moop

Carteira Habilitação: Categoria C, D, E

Conhecimento Técnico: Conhecimento profundo dos sistemas de lubrificação e manutenção de equipamentos de linha amarela. Capacidade de seguir manuais técnicos e especificações do fabricante.

Atenção aos Detalhes: Habilidade para identificar áreas que necessitam de lubrificação e detectar sinais de problemas em equipamentos.

Segurança: Comprometimento com as práticas de segurança e uso de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPI) para garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro.

Comunicação: Boas habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe, colaborando com outros profissionais para garantir a eficiência operacional.

title: Procurement Analyst
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Operations at TRACTIAN

The operations team is responsible for turning our IoT devices into reality. We strive to make the impossible possible and are deeply goal-oriented. We integrate hardware, production, quality, and supply and we're in charge of the whole manufacturing process of our hardware, from the purchase of components to the final adapting of our devices to meet strict international criteria.

What you'll do

As a Procurement Analyst at Tractian, you'll be responsible for efficiently executing purchasing activities as part of the Supply Chain team. Your responsibilities will range from creating purchase orders to negotiating with local suppliers, ensuring alignment with requesting areas, and monitoring supplier performance. Additionally, you'll focus on ensuring product and service compliance while optimizing the speed of execution and delivery of these items.

Responsibilities

  • Develop new suppliers, including negotiating products and services.
  • Execute routine purchases, input orders into the SAP system, and monitor the delivery of negotiated items.
  • Serve as the interface between suppliers and internal requesting areas.
  • Ensure shared suppliers are effectively managed.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs to track supplier performance, continuously driving improvements in cost, lead times, and quality.
  • Identify and escalate issues that may impact Operations.

Requirements

  • Experience with procurement processes and supporting tools, including tax knowledge, negotiation skills, and the sourcing process.
  • Experience in negotiating supplier contracts.
  • Experience in ensuring compliance with procurement.
  • Practical experience related to the indirect material category.
  • Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Procurement, or Engineering.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with ERP SAP B1 or similar.
  • Experience with negotiating Marketing and Facilities items.
  • Advanced English.

Compensation:

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Education and courses stipend
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years
  • Day off during the week of your birthday

  • Software development expertise in any complementary area to our core business, such as data warehouses, specialized development platforms, infrastructure automation, services provisioning, real-time systems, fault-tolerant systems, and mission-critical systems;

  • Experience with computer networks, latency, package loss, routing optimization, monitoring, and problem-solving;
  • Full knowledge of SQL and relational databases;
  • Expertise in at least one functional or logic programming language
  • Comfortable with challenges of concurrency problems and has already worked in distributed and asynchronous systems;

  • Constant discussions about our practices and systems, everybody that wants to speak out will be heard and we are open to new ideas, practices, and tools;
  • You will be free to dedicate part of your time to improve our systems and implement quality features that make us more efficient or less error-prone;
  • Annual performance evaluations;

EBANX offers:

  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;

  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents, and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX
  • Hello ebanker: psychology, finance and legal orientation.
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics store and more!

title: Cloud Field Engineering Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

This is an opportunity to lead a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions across public clouds and data centers. The role involves working with a broad spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu to virtualization, private cloud, Kubernetes, and advanced open source solutions like MLops platforms and data platforms. As Canonical expands into new industries such as telecom, finance, healthcare, and media, we develop new open source solutions tailored to their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers, comfortable troubleshooting technical issues and engaging in technical presales. They should contribute technically but focus more on shaping team direction, focus, and delivery. We also focus on growing management skills and soft skills in our engineers.

Our goal is to make open source easier, reliable, and secure, aiming to provide 'most software to most companies'. We select engineers globally for brilliance and motivation, and our managers help teams achieve their potential and take pride in their results.

The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical

The team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical works directly with customers to design private and public cloud solutions tailored to workload needs. Technologies include on-premise solutions like Openstack, MicroCloud, Ceph, and deployable solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL. Managers and team members deploy, test, and hand over solutions, and participate in presales to advise during sales processes.

The manager is responsible for line management, career guidance, developing engineering talent, representing the team technically, and driving collaboration with other teams and customers. Active participation in presales is also expected.

Location

This role is home-based, managing a team in your time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting technologies and acting as a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in your time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and provide career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and products to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and promote best engineering and organizational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on goals and projects
  • Participate in leadership team collaborations

What we are looking for in you

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies (Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph)
  • Practical Linux and networking skills
  • Experience in technical presales
  • Dynamic personality, proactive in new projects and interacting with people
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Passion for developing and growing people
  • Experience leading, coaching, and mentoring engineers
  • Organized, ensuring timely, high-quality results
  • Strong academic background
  • Willingness to travel up to 40%, attending events and meetings

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language (Spanish or French) preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience with external partnerships
  • Stakeholder engagement with internal teams and engineering roadmaps

What we offer you

Our compensation considers location, experience, and performance, with annual reviews and performance bonuses. Benefits include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • USD 2,000 yearly learning and development budget
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards, holiday leave, parental leave, Employee Assistance Programme
  • Travel opportunities and upgrades for company events

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster excellence. Since 2004, as a remote-first company, we challenge you to think differently, learn new skills, and innovate.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion, offering fair consideration regardless of background or identity.

title: Senior UI/UX Researcher
description:
About us

At WinTech, we are at the forefront of innovation, crafting cutting-edge consumer products that shape the future. Our diverse portfolio spans the health, education, and entertainment sectors, offering exciting opportunities to make a real impact. Our dynamic teams are the driving force behind our success, and we’re always on the lookout for passionate individuals eager to join us on this journey of transformation.

About the role

We are looking for a result-driven Mid-to-Senior UX Researcher who will play a crucial role in building up our product and improving our user experience by conducting research, analysing user behaviour, and designing intuitive wireframes for both desktop and mobile.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct competitors & market research to understand user behaviors & flows, pain points, and needs.

  • Analyse existing user interfaces and design of our own solutions.

  • Utilise tools like Visily or Figma to create wireframes, prototypes, and mockups.

  • Develop user personas, customer journey maps, and usability studies to drive data-informed decisions.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and designers to ensure seamless user experiences.

  • Test and validate design concepts through A/B testing, surveys, interviews, and analytics.

  • Document research findings and present insights to stakeholders.

  • Stay up to date with industry trends and UX best practices to continually refine our approach.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in UX research and UI/UX design.

  • Proficiency in Visily (preferred), Figma, and similar design tools.

  • Strong knowledge of user-centered design (UCD), usability principles, and accessibility standards.

  • Experience conducting user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and data analysis.

  • Ability to translate research insights into actionable recommendations.

  • A basic understanding of front-end development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) is a plus.

  • Familiarity with A/B testing, heatmaps, and analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Hotjar).

  • Strong analytical mindset and ability to work with data-driven UX decisions.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

  • Portfolio or case studies showcasing past research and wireframe designs.

Nice to have

  • Experience working in fast-paced startup environments.

  • Experience with AI-driven UX research tools and methodologies.

Location

WinTech operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here:

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at WinTech

At WinTech, you'll join a supportive and collaborative team passionate about excellence and being industry leaders. Our innovative work environment drives impactful business results as we challenge ourselves and elevate each other to achieve new heights.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job description

QUEM SOMOS?

Prazer, somos a Suzano! Aqui a gente acredita que inovação e sustentabilidade caminham juntas. Dessa união, nasce uma atitude plena de significado: a inovabilidade. Pautados por ela, pensamos fora da caixa e enxergamos longe para lidar com os desafios do século 21. Nós plantamos e cultivamos árvores para transformar essa matéria-prima renovável em Bioprodutos para o dia a dia de mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas.

PLURAL

Iguais e diferentes. Singulares e plurais. Acreditamos que a diversidade nos fortalece, por isso, não fazemos distinção entre candidatos seja por deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética.

Main responsibilities

DADOS:

GS 16

Local: Rio de Janeiro

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

  • Responder pela Ex-Mill, Margem de Contribuição, Volume, Faturamento, Distribuição Numérica e Ponderada - dentre outros indicadores de sua região, assegurando o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela companhia;
  • Atuar de acordo com a Rotina de Trabalho Suzano estabelecida para os clientes/canais de atendimento Direto ou Indireto, independente do modelo: Matricial ou Dedicado;
  • Garantir a execução SUZANO no PDV (Loja Perfeita) - Mix Mínimo, Planograma, Precificação, Qualidade, Exposição e presença de Material de PDV;
  • Presença no Mercado (área sob sua responsabilidade) de acordo com a definição do Processo de Vendas, identificando oportunidades e ameaças da concorrência;
  • Aplicar a política comercial Suzano de acordo com a estratégia para a região, canal ou cliente sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Garantir a melhoria contínua do resultado de seus clientes, garantindo assim a manutenção de sua carteira;
  • Estabelecer Planos de Negócios – JBP, para as contas/clientes sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Gerenciar contas e clientes sob sua responsabilidade: monitoramento de estoques, colocação de pedidos, acompanhamento do faturamento, monitoramento das entregas e monitoramento dos pagamentos, entre outras atividades, inerentes a função;
  • Realizar o planejamento colaborativo de Demanda de produtos;
  • Prospectar clientes com potencial e que estejam dentro do perfil de produtos SUZANO;
  • Explorar detalhadamente cada ponto da sua verba off-invoice, quando disponível;
  • Atuar e monitorar o Sell Out nos seus clientes, sugerindo promoções, ações de merchandising ou campanhas que atinjam os consumidores dos seus produtos;

Requirements and skills

QUEM NOS INSPIRA?

  • Alguém que acredite em nossos valores;
  • Com iniciativa;
  • Perfil analítico;
  • Que proponha ideias e soluções.

O QUE A SUZANO ESPERA DE VOCÊ?

  • Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Disponibilidade de viagens;
  • Desejável conhecimento em: Pacote Office; Matemática Financeira; Alavancas Comerciais; Técnicas de Negociação;
  • Conhecer do mercado e clientes de bens de consumo do mercado/da região;
  • Ter conhecimento dos clientes e varejistas da região de atuação;
  • Ser dinâmico, comunicativo, negociador, proativo, resiliente e com foco em resultados.

Additional information

NÓS TEMOS MUITO MAIS QUE UM PAPEL NA SUA VIDA!

Cuidados da sua saúde: Plano Médico, Odonto e Seguro de Vida; VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional; Sabemos que a renda fixa é importante, mas, além disso, oferecemos uma renda extra por meio do nosso Programa de Remuneração Variável (Anual); Para você se preparar para o futuro temos a Previdência privada; Praticamos o home office em áreas corporativas, a flexibilidade de horários, além do dress code casual; Para gerar e compartilhar valor disponibilizamos cursos e treinamentos E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, o UniverSuzano; Na Suzano, só é bom para nós se for bom para o mundo! Por isso, durante o ano realizamos muitas ações legais e você poderá se tornar um voluntário do nosso programa Voluntariar; Também contamos com um Clube de Descontos, com diversos parceiros, para você aproveitar!

PARA A FAMÍLIA

Como empresa cidadã, entendemos a importância da chegada de uma criança. Por isso, oferecemos extensão da licença paternidade para 20 dias e maternidade para 180 dias. O benefício também vale para papais e mamães que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homo afetivos; Para as mamães retornarem tranquilas ao trabalho, oferecemos um auxílio creche bem bacana.

SUZANO FAZ BEM

Você poderá participar do #GrupoDeCorridaSuzano, um projeto pensado para manter a sua saúde em dia; Receber atendimento nutricional; Praticar ginástica laboral; Usar o Gympass na academia de sua preferência, salas com manicure e massagem; Aproveitar o Espaço Faz Bem com mesas de jogos. E, se você jogar um bolão, por aqui sempre realizamos e incentivamos os campeonatos internos!

Contar com a assessoria do Disque Viver Bem, para atendimentos via 0800 com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, nutricionistas, pet consultoria, educadores físicos e profissionais da área jurídica.

Faça parte do time de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo!

Nosso propósito é Tornar o Mundo um Lugar Mais Seguro e não vamos parar até conseguir, pois somos incansáveis e pensamos positivamente.

Nossa paixão? Cuidar de todos, sejam eles clientes, o planeta ou nossos colaboradores pois as pessoas são importantes para nós.

Trabalhamos para que as pessoas vivam tranquilamente, tanto em seu ambiente físico quanto no digital, a fim de gerar um impacto positivo em sua vida pessoal e profissional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, presente em 26 países e com mais de 160.000 funcionários em todo o mundo. Somos uma das empresas líderes mundiais do setor de Segurança Privada, que oferece Soluções Integradas de Segurança, adaptadas às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Toda nossa história não seria possível sem um time de heróis e por isso desenvolvemos diariamente programas específicos para atrair novos talentos e promovemos a carreira dos nossos profissionais com treinamentos contínuos e oportunidades internas de crescimento.

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

O Programa Somos Todos Heróis - Diversidade e Respeito vem para fortalecer e apoiar o nosso posicionamento a favor do Respeito e da Inclusão e para trazer conhecimento e conscientização a todos os nossos Heróis. Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora.

Atender e servir os clientes, demonstrar produtos e efetuar vendas apresentando promoções. Cooperar com conferências, armazenagens e organização de mercadorias. Arrumar os balcões no layout exigido, primando pela aparência (beleza e fartura), limpeza e facilidade de transitar no setor. Manter as ferramentas e a área de trabalho limpa, higienizada e organizada. Verificar diariamente a validade de todos os produtos que fazem parte da seção, retirar de exposição os produtos vencidos e com aparência inadequada. Cortar e fatiar as peças de frios sempre que necessário e/ou de acordo com o pedido do cliente respeitando escolhas de marca, expessura e quantidades. Manter a limpeza, conservação e organização do ambiente a fim de evitar acidentes e infestação de insetos. Embalar, precificar, repor e arrumar os produtos, seguindo o encarte e PVPS (Primeiro que Vence, Primeiro que Sai), sempre que necessário, conforme exposição definida. Atender bem os clientes e esclarecer dúvidas (marcas e preços), sendo cordial, educado e atencioso. Acompanhar os índices de perdas e descartes dos produtos, buscando as melhores medidas a fim de reduzir o índice de perda de produtos. Receber reclamações com serenidade e empatia, tentando solucionar o problema quando for simples fazê-lo, quando não, reporta-se a liderança para que possa finalizar o atendimento e resolver o problema, não entrar em embate com os clientes. Zelar pela limpeza e organização de seu local de trabalho, utensílios e maquinários utilizados no setor. Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure Pipelines, incorporating security and performance testing
  • Expertise in Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with Datadog strongly preferred, including real-time alerting and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with Hub-and-Spoke network architecture and cloud security principles
  • Strong database administration experience with Azure SQL Server, including cloud-based backup, replication, and high-availability strategies. Experience with the Hyperscale service tier is a strong plus.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, incident management, and high-availability architectures
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, including security compliance, role-based access control, and vulnerability management
  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.
  • Ability to thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced remote work environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience supporting a remote team
  • Azure and/or Security certification(s) a plus

Responsibilities
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures

Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

description:
Operador de caixa

Qual será a sua missão?

Operar o caixa/PDV, registrando cuidadosamente e corretamente as compras, preservando os produtos, mantendo a qualidade e garantindo bom atendimento e satisfação dos clientes.

Quais são as principais responsabilidades

  1. Realizar atendimento ao cliente de forma empática e diferenciada;
  2. Organizar o caixa/PDV, proporcionando agilidade no atendimento, bem como realizar todas as atividades inerentes à função;
  3. Identificar diariamente os produtos disponíveis para venda e oferecer ao cliente adequadamente;
  4. Zelar pela segurança e bom uso dos equipamentos, manter o ambiente de trabalho e instrumentos limpos e organizados, cuidar da higiene pessoal e do uniforme, de acordo com a legislação e normas vigentes.

O perfil que buscamos em você!

  • Comunicação clara e empática com o cliente;
  • Relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Trabalho em equipe;
  • Organização;
  • Orientação para o cliente;
  • Comprometimento com o resultado.

O que precisa ter?

Ensino médio completo.

Quais são os benefícios?

  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Refeitório;
  • Cesta básica;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Convênio farmácia;
  • Programa de treinamentos;
  • Trilha de carreira;
  • Descontos em cursos e universidades parceiras.

Todas as nossas oportunidades também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

Adicionais benefícios: alimentação no local, plano de saúde, seguro de vida, convênio farmácia.

Sobre a empresa

Somos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras, ajudando-os a ter uma vida mais saudável.

Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas em 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG). Nossas lojas atendem cerca de meio milhão de clientes por mês, com operações omnichannel, incluindo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces, entregando em até três horas em regiões atendidas. Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos mensalmente, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas.

Nossa missão é promover uma vida mais natural, tornando-nos referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil. Nossos valores incluem jogo aberto, foco em resultados com qualidade, trabalho em equipe, excelência no atendimento, um jeito simples e alegre de ser, e atitude responsável.

Valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, promovendo ambientes seguros, acolhedores, criativos e inclusivos. Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, bem como para todas as raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais.

description:
Job description

Executar plano de manutenção preditiva em equipamentos da indústria e auxiliar na execução dos serviços de manutenção em máquinas operatrizes, motores, dispositivos e equipamentos industriais, reparando e substituindo peças, fazendo ajustes, regulagem e lubrificação convenientes, utilizando máquinas, ferramentas e instrumentos de medição e controle, para assegurar-lhes o funcionamento regular e eficiente.


Main responsibilities

  1. Realizar inspeções de rotina para diagnosticar o estado de conservação e funcionamento dos equipamentos mecânicos;
  2. Executar planos de manutenção preditiva conforme criticidade dos equipamentos estabelecido;
  3. Realizar análises de vibração, temperatura e sensitiva nos equipamentos da indústria;
  4. Elaborar relatório de diagnóstico e prognóstico dos equipamentos que estão com vibração acima do recomendado pela norma ISO-10816-3 – 1998;
  5. Realizar melhoria continua no banco de dados dos equipamentos, e sempre cadastrar os novos equipamentos e garantir qualidade nas informações;
  6. Executar as rotas de análises conforme periodicidade definida pela criticidade dos equipamentos;
  7. Executar os trabalhos seguindo as ordens de serviço, checklist e outras atividades geradas pelo planejamento;
  8. Auxiliar na regulagem e calibragem de todos os equipamentos mecânicos e pneumáticos, conforme especificações de cada máquina, utilizando-se de instrumentos e ferramentas apropriadas;
  9. Auxiliar na manutenção, reparos e consertos mecânicos em: bombas em geral, redutores de velocidade, esteiras transportadoras, montagens de rolamentos e redutores, gaxetas, alinhamento e nivelamento de máquinas, elevadores de caneca, moinhos e outros, garantindo a melhor técnica aplicada nos ajustes mecânicos;
  10. Solicitar requisição de peças para reparos conforme relatórios de prognósticos e diagnósticos;
  11. Auxiliar na verificação e ajuste do alinhamento, centralização e nivelamento de todos os equipamentos e acessórios, identificando e informando sobre as falhas operacionais na produção;
  12. Verificar o estado de rolamentos, trocando-os se necessário, de acordo com padrões estabelecidos;
  13. Realizar lubrificação em todas as máquinas e equipamentos do setor industrial, seguindo um plano estabelecido para fazer as lubrificações, de acordo com o planejamento do setor quando necessário;
  14. Cuidar da ordem e limpeza da área e material de trabalho;
  15. Anotar os reparos feitos, peças trocadas, para efeito de controle;
  16. Zelar pelas ferramentas, equipamentos de precisão e materiais utilizados;
  17. Efetuar apontamentos necessários conforme plano de manutenção preventiva/preditiva;
  18. Fazer checklist de rota de manutenção;
  19. Realizar relatório mensal da saúde dos ativos monitorados;
  20. Executar as atividades da função respeitando todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente do trabalho, estabelecidos pela organização, bem como, utilizar constantemente todos os EPIs de uso obrigatório no desenvolvimento das atividades do cargo e do setor. Tendo a responsabilidade de informar ao seu superior imediato qualquer atividade que apresente risco a sua saúde ou dos demais colegas de trabalho;
  21. Exercer as atividades em comum acordo com os valores, políticas, diretrizes, procedimentos e processos da empresa, sempre focando nas metas organizacionais, e mantendo sigilo e protegendo as informações da companhia;
  22. Manter a disciplina no programa 5S, objetivando um trabalho seguro por meio da manutenção da organização, padronização e limpeza do ambiente de trabalho;
  23. Zelar pelas propriedades da empresa sob sua responsabilidade, informando ao superior imediato qualquer problema ou avaria detectada;
  24. Apoio as equipes da manutenção e do processo industrial, nas atividades necessárias para garantir a disponibilidade dos equipamentos industriais.

Requirements and skills

  1. Curso Técnico em mecânica e/ou áreas afins;
  2. Curso em análise de vibração.

  • Realizar a garantia de segurança, conforme previsto no SGSO, enviando relatórios de segurança aos destinatários apropriados (ou seja, proprietários do processo, gerente responsável, conselho de revisão de segurança);
  • Promover a cultura de segurança, assessorando e apoiando as diferentes unidades;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia Aeronáutica, ou equivalente.
  • CNH B
  • Pacote Office Avançado
  • Conhecimento em Legislação ANAC
  • Conhecimento em Gereciamento SGSO

title: Concurso Público para Engenheiro e Arquiteto em Paulínia
description:
A prefeitura de Paulínia abre concurso público para o preenchimento de vagas e formação de cadastro reserva para cargos de engenheiro civil , engenheiro agrônomo , engenheiro elétrico e arquiteto .

Para estas vagas a remuneração vai de R$ 3.867,50 a R$ 5.000,00 com direito a diversos benefícios e jornada de trabalho semanal de 40 horas.

As inscrições para o concurso público da Prefeitura Municipal de Paulínia iniciam-se em 30 de março de 2016 e terminam em 25 de abril de 2016 conforme descrito no edital .

O concurso é destinado ao provimento de 63 vagas e a formação de cadastro reserva (CR), para cargos em que é requerida formação de nível médio e de nível superior.

São diversos os cargos mas destacamos aqui os de engenheiro agrônomo (CR), engenheiro civil (03 vagas), engenheiro elétrico (CR) e arquiteto (CR).

Para engenheiro civil, agrônomo ou elétrico a remuneração prevista é de R$ 5.000,00. Já para arquiteto a remuneração prevista é de R$ 3.867,50. Para ambos os cargos são oferecidos, conforme previsto em lei, 14° salário (Leis nº 1.965/96, 2.431/02 e 2.504/02), auxílio alimentação de R$ 100,00 (Lei nº 2.490/01), auxílio transporte de R$ 28,00 (Lei nº 1.081/87 e Decreto 4.246/97) além de auxílio saúde de R$ 35,00 (Lei nº 2.493/01) e a carga horária semanal de trabalho é de 40 horas.

Além dos já citados, existem também os seguintes cargos para profissionais de nível superior: Professor (diversas especialidades), Médico Plantonista (clínico e pediatra), Cirurgião Dentista Plantonista, Veterinário, Contador, Analista de Sistemas, Diretor de Unidade Escolar e Procurador.

Para nível médio, os cargos são: Ag. de Desenvolvimento Infantil, Ag. de Administração Pública, Ag.de Fiscalização, Monitor Escolar, Orientador Social e Ag. de Controle de Vetor.

Inscrição no concurso

Os interessados em inscreverem-se no concurso público para os cargos mencionados deverão acessar a página de inscrição no site da FGV Projetos clicando aqui .

Mais informações sobre o concurso público para a Prefeitura Municipal de Paulínia podem ser obtidas pelo telefone 0800 2834628 e pelo e-mail concursoprefeituradepaulinia2016 @ fgv.br a partir de 24/03/2016.

title: Sales Operations Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Sales Operations Analyst role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring Sales Operations Analysts to join a team of experts who help Canonical sales teams achieve their business goals. The Sales Operations team drives continuous process and data quality improvement to ensure orders are processed correctly. The successful candidate will be a leader who shows initiative in improving the way the team works, maintaining compliance and associated governance.
The success of the role is measured against increasing the velocity of deals and the quality of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data used to drive key business decisions. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver and team player who is passionate about the opportunity to partner with sales leadership, is also passionate about our role in the technology industry bringing open source to a wider audience of innovators and enterprises, and will design and drive programs in support of Canonical's continued success.
Location: These roles will be based remotely in the EMEA and Americas regions.
The role entails

  • Support all aspects of the day-to-day operations of the sales function globally
  • Review opportunities for accuracy and provision orders on successful closure of a deal
  • Support the Sales Operations Manager to improve sales data quality and processes
  • Report on data quality metrics to executive level stakeholders
  • Implement surveys and define metrics for executive level stakeholders
  • Support the sales team globally on CRM and other sales operations systems
  • Deliver sales metrics, dashboards and other ad-hoc analytical tasks
  • Lead automation and streamline the Lead to Order process
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and university
  • Experience in a sales operations/sales order processing role
  • Experience in a technology subscription-based business
  • Experience driving data quality improvement
  • Energetic, thoughtful, systematic approach, focused on robust, repeatable and scalable outcomes
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to work productively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization on a global scale
  • Ability to manage across boundaries and communicate effectively, particularly working with Sales, Legal, Finance and Marketing teams
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
What Canonical offers
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Job Title: Account Manager / Strategic Growth Partner

Position Overview: The Strategic Growth Partner is responsible for overseeing the complete sales and recruitment lifecycle with the client, ensuring efficient client management from lead to onboarding. This role focuses on taking initial discovery calls, understanding client job description needs, delivering service, maintaining organized workflows, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve client satisfaction and operational excellence.

About Us: Virtustant is a rapidly growing global staffing solutions provider dedicated to matching exceptional professionals with companies across various industries. Our mission is to connect businesses with the right talent to drive success and innovation. With a focus on quality, reliability, and efficiency, we strive to exceed the expectations of both our clients and candidates.

Key Responsibilities

Client-Focused Responsibilities:

  1. Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients during the sales and recruitment process, ensuring clear communication and timely updates.
  2. Being knowledgeable on pricing, job descriptions, and long-term planning to build strong relationships with the client.
  3. Conduct structured follow-ups at key milestones (e.g., after Discovery Calls, during recruitment phases) to ensure client satisfaction and alignment.
  4. Gather and analyze client feedback regarding the recruitment process and provide actionable insights.
  5. Manage client expectations and address concerns promptly during the recruitment phase.

Candidate-Focused Responsibilities:

  1. Develop a comprehensive initial job description that provides clear guidelines and expectations for the recruitment team. This description should outline the key responsibilities, qualifications, and skills required for the role, ensuring that it serves as a reliable foundation for the recruitment efforts.
  2. Help vetting and shortlisting candidates for client review.
  3. Organize and facilitate candidate interviews, ensuring client readiness through detailed instructions and guidelines.

Operational Responsibilities:

  1. Collaborate with Recruitment and HR teams to ensure timely and efficient delivery of services, including handoffs for new roles or clients.
  2. Maintain comprehensive records of client interactions, feedback, and performance metrics for continuous improvement.
  3. Be a part of Ruling Meetings with recruiters to evaluate candidate viability and finalize shortlists.
  4. Oversee and streamline the contract and payment processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  5. Facilitate the transition of clients to HR Consultants for ongoing role management once hiring is complete.
  6. Propose and implement process improvements, including automation and documentation updates.

Recurring Tasks:

Client-Facing Tasks

  1. Schedule and conduct follow-ups post-Discovery Call.
  2. Facilitate hiring processes, including sending General Contract and Payment documentation, providing onboarding recommendations, and ensuring smooth transitions.
  3. Handle new hiring processes, ensuring a smooth process as needed.

Internal Operational Tasks:

  1. Collaborate on the creation and refinement of processes, automation, and internal documentation.
  2. Support cross-departmental initiatives by sharing information, managing exceptional cases, and contributing to training materials.
  3. Develop and maintain organizational policies and internal guides.
  4. Conduct regular check-ins with recruiters to address day-to-day topics and ensure alignment.

Qualifications and Skills:

  1. Proven experience in sales, or client relationship management.
  2. Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities.
  3. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  4. Proficiency in CRM systems, scheduling tools, and communication platforms.
  5. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  6. Analytical mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and results.

Language Requirement:

  1. C2 Level of English Proficiency.

Reporting and Collaboration:

  1. Reports to the Sales Manager.
  2. Collaborates closely with recruiters, HR Consultants, and marketing teams.
  3. Serves as a liaison between clients and internal teams to ensure seamless communication and process execution.
  4. Conduct annual reviews to reflect on performance metrics and plan for future needs.

Performance Metrics:

  1. Number of leads successfully converted to clients.
  2. Timeliness and accuracy in the recruitment process and offboarding activities.
  3. Client satisfaction during the process and after onboarding.
  4. Successful placement rates and feedback from clients.

Salary and Benefits:

  1. Weekly Payment in USD or Local Currency according to your preference.
  2. Commission structure available on top of base salary.
  3. 100% remote position
  4. 10 days of paid time off annually
  5. 6 paid holidays (3 fixed and 3 flexible)

title: UX Designer
description:
Join to apply for the UX Designer role at VML .

At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, offering deep insights in communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work.

Who We Are Looking For

The UX Designer will work directly with external clients, understanding their needs and providing user-centered design solutions that enhance digital experiences. The candidate must be proficient in Figma, Sketch, or similar design tools and should have experience in user research, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing. They must be able to maintain fluent conversations in English and possess a Bachelor's degree in fields related to UX/UI Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a similar discipline.

What You'll Do

  1. UX Design:
    • User research: interviews, surveys, usability testing
    • Creation and tracking of wireframes, prototypes, and experience maps
    • Analysis of user flows and experience optimization
    • Definition of interaction strategies and intuitive navigation
  2. UI Design:
    • Visual design of attractive interfaces, focusing on aesthetics and functionality
    • Creation of scalable and consistent design systems
    • Knowledge of component creation and usage
    • Use of design tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, etc.
    • Development of interactive and high-fidelity prototypes
    • Knowledge in building brand guidelines (UI kits)

What You'll Need

  • Advanced English (must)
  • Proven experience in UX design
  • Academic background in UX/UI
  • Design tools: Figma (must), Sketch, Illustrator, Photoshop, Adobe XD, InVision, Zeplin, Miro
  • Communication skills: Presenting and defending design proposals to stakeholders

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

VML is a WPP Agency. For more information, please visit our website, and follow VML on our social channels via Instagram, LinkedIn, and X.

Disponibilidade para home-office
Responsabilidades e Experiências Desejáveis
PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Arquitetar, projetar e implementar soluções de infraestrutura, garantindo alinhamento com os requisitos de aplicação e as melhores práticas de cibersegurança, com foco em infraestruturas locais (on-premises).
  • Arquitetar, projetar, implementar e manter soluções conteinerizadas no OpenShift, Docker e Kubernetes, incluindo o uso de Operators do Kubernetes, com foco em infraestruturas locais.
  • Arquitetar e desenvolver estratégias e implementações de infraestrutura como código (IaC), com foco em infraestruturas locais, principalmente utilizando Terraform / Terragrunt e Ansible, para gerenciar infraestruturas com forte ênfase em ambientes OpenShift e Kubernetes.
  • Definir e orientar o desenvolvimento de pipelines de CI/CD especificamente voltados para implantações locais em OpenShift e Kubernetes, automatizando os processos de build, teste e implantação, com foco em Jenkins e integração com repositórios de artefatos como Artifactory, JFrog Xray e Nexus.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de infraestrutura e desenvolvimento para integrar práticas de cibersegurança (SecOps) em todo o ciclo de vida da infraestrutura e do desenvolvimento de software, fornecendo orientação arquitetural e garantindo documentação e segurança no contexto do OpenShift e Kubernetes.
  • Estruturar, desenvolver e otimizar práticas e ferramentas de DevSecOps nos ambientes, contribuindo com a melhoria contínua por meio de frameworks de automação de testes, ferramentas de análise de código como o SonarQube, e outras ferramentas de varredura de cibersegurança.
  • Projetar e supervisionar a implementação de soluções abrangentes de log, monitoramento e alertas, como Prometheus, Grafana, Loki e Alertmanager, para garantir operação do sistema, desempenho e detecção proativa de incidentes dentro do ecossistema OpenShift e Kubernetes.
  • Fornecer orientação especializada e liderar a resposta a incidentes relacionados à infraestrutura, aplicações e implantações, com foco específico em ambientes locais de OpenShift e Kubernetes.
  • Documentar decisões arquiteturais, processos, incluindo protocolos de instalação, especificações técnicas (BSDS) e documentação relevante para GxP, garantindo gestão do conhecimento e conformidade.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as mais recentes tecnologias e tendências em DevSecOps, com forte ênfase em OpenShift e Kubernetes locais, definindo a direção estratégica para sua adoção.
Requisitos
  • Formação em Engenharia da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro ou Arquiteto DevSecOps, com significativa atuação em ambientes locais (on-premises).
  • Sólido entendimento dos princípios e práticas de DevOps, SecOps e GitOps, com foco estratégico em infraestruturas locais.
  • Experiência extensa com gerenciamento de infraestrutura local, incluindo sistemas Linux e provisionamento por meio de IaC, com capacidade comprovada de definir arquiteturas de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência profunda com tecnologias de conteinerização, especialmente OpenShift, Docker e Kubernetes, incluindo o uso de Operators do Kubernetes e a capacidade de projetar plataformas conteinerizadas escaláveis e seguras.
  • Experiência com ferramentas específicas do OpenShift como Harbor, ACS (Advanced Cluster Security), Argo CD (GitOps) e ACM (Advanced Cluster Management), com foco em sua integração arquitetural.
  • Experiência comprovada na definição e implementação de estratégias de IaC utilizando ferramentas como Terraform / Terragrunt e Ansible, voltadas para automação de infraestrutura em ambientes locais.
  • Experiência comprovada na definição e condução da implementação de pipelines CI/CD com Jenkins / CloudBees, Azure DevOps, para aplicações conteinerizadas em OpenShift e Kubernetes.
  • Experiência com repositórios de artefatos como Artifactory e XRay (da JFrog) e Nexus (da Sonatype), incluindo seu papel em cadeias de fornecimento de software seguras.
  • Experiência com ferramentas adicionais da HashiCorp como Vault, Consul, Nomad e Packer, e sua aplicação em projetos arquiteturais.
  • Experiência com frameworks de automação de testes, ferramentas de análise de código e varredura de segurança, como SonarQube, e capacidade de integrá-los ao ciclo de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de log, monitoramento e alertas voltadas para OpenShift e Kubernetes, como Prometheus, Grafana, Loki e Alertmanager, com capacidade de projetar soluções abrangentes de observabilidade.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de script como Python e Bash, com capacidade de desenvolver scripts para automação de tarefas arquiteturais.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias Scrum ou Ágeis, com experiência como líder técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Experiência com a suíte Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket) e sua aplicação na documentação e comunicação de decisões arquiteturais.
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados por GxP e compreensão dos requisitos GxP, com capacidade de projetar soluções em conformidade.
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais, analíticas e de resolução de problemas, com forte capacidade de pensar estrategicamente e de forma holística.
  • Português fluente e nível intermediário a avançado em inglês.
Desejável
  • Certificações relevantes como ITIL v4 Foundation ou superior são altamente valorizadas.
  • Certificações relevantes em OpenShift/Kubernetes, como CKA, CKS, Red Hat Certified Specialist em OpenShift, são altamente valorizadas.
  • Proficiência profunda em princípios de cibersegurança da informação, boas práticas e frameworks como ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework e CIS Top Critical Security Controls.
  • Conhecimento em frameworks JavaScript.
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning e sua aplicação em DevSecOps em ambientes locais, incluindo infraestrutura, CI/CD, cibersegurança e análise de código, com capacidade de projetar soluções futuras com base nessas tecnologias.

  • Realizar estudos de mercado para identificar tendências, mudanças no comportamento do consumidor e novas demandas no segmento;
  • Monitorar a atuação de concorrentes e antecipar movimentos estratégicos que impactem o setor;
  • Colaborar com a alta gestão no desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais que aumentem a participação de mercado;
  • Revisar regularmente o portfólio de produtos e serviços, propondo ajustes que otimizem a adequação ao mercado HORECA;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes internas, como marketing e operações, para garantir entregas alinhadas às expectativas dos clientes;
  • Sugerir e implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos de vendas e atendimento;
  • Estabelecer metas claras e desafiadoras para o segmento, acompanhando seu desempenho por meio de KPIs relevantes;
  • Analisar resultados e preparar relatórios detalhados com insights que contribuam para decisões estratégicas;

  • Zelar pela limpeza e organização do ambiente de trabalho;

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável pós-graduação ou especialização em áreas como Gestão de Negócios, Vendas ou Marketing.
  • Conhecimento avançado do segmento HORECA (Hotéis, Restaurantes e Cafés).
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e sistemas de gestão empresarial (ERP).
  • Experiência em análise de mercado, inteligência comercial e estratégias de expansão.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado e proficiência em PowerPoint para apresentações.
  • Experiência comprovada em posições similares, especialmente na estruturação de áreas ou projetos em negócios B2B.

description:
Join a team that delivers excellence.

Lehigh Valley Health Network (LVHN) is home to nearly 23,000 colleagues who make up our talented, vibrant and diverse workforce. Join our team and experience firsthand what it's like to be part of a health care organization that's nationally recognized, forward–thinking and offers plenty of opportunity to do great work.

Imagine a career at one of the nation's most advanced health networks.


Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward–thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.


LVHN has been ranked among the "Best Hospitals" by U.S. News & World Report for 23 consecutive years. We're a Magnet(tm) Hospital, having been honored five times with the American Nurses Credentialing Center's prestigious distinction for nursing excellence and quality patient outcomes in our Lehigh Valley region. Finally, Lehigh Valley Hospital – Cedar Crest, Lehigh Valley Hospital – Muhlenberg, Lehigh Valley Hospital– Hazleton, and Lehigh Valley Hospital – Pocono each received an 'A' grade on the Hospital Safety Grade from The Leapfrog Group in 2020, the highest grade in patient safety. These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.


Summary

Assists the radiologist in various radiology procedures by prepping patients beforehand through explaining the process to them, checking their vital signs, administering medicine, and providing care for patients undergoing imaging procedures. Provides nursing services, helps to carry out physician orders, responds and reports to attending/radiologist any changes in condition, oversees the distribution of medications, charts medications, distributes/counts narcotics, and responds to emergencies.


Job Duties
  • Assesses patients prior to their procedures by studying patient medical histories, reviewing patient history and Lab values, and speaking with both patients and their physicians.
  • Administers conscious sedation per hospital policy.
  • Helps patients better understand the procedures they need and serves as a liaison between the patient, nursing staff, and physician. Attends to the needs of the patient while in Radiology. Provides proper patient care, comfort, and understanding at all times.
  • Communicates with RN or patient's physician any change in status, medications given, and any intervention taken, including transportation of patient back to unit if indicated. Initiates post procedure orders and communicates all pertinent data to the nursing unit and accompanies patient to unit, if indicated.
  • Discharges patient from interventional per Aldrette score/Anesthesia guidelines.
  • Inputs all LDA lines in EPic. Documents that a implanted supply has been exported in patients chart in EPic.
  • Responds to all code blues and RRT within Radiology. Assists radiologists and code teams as needed.
  • Collaborates with Pediatric Intensivist for sedation of Pediatric cases. Follows PALS guidelines.
  • Performs pre and post procedure telephone calls for outpatients.
  • Follows National Patient Safety Goals including complete Invasive Procedure Checklist and patient identification. Completes patient safety reports, as indicated.
  • Serves as a clinical resource for the nursing staff, patients, and healthcare providers.
  • Maintains equipment and room cleanliness. Puts unused supplies away and restocks as needed. Assumes responsibility for cleanliness and sanitation of the immediate work area. Does light housekeeping. Maintains orderliness.
  • Provides radiation protection in accordance with prescribed safety standards. Assumes responsibility and accountability for his/her own safety and the safety of others.
  • Assists in the education and training of new employees, students, and other ancillary personnel.

Minimum Qualifications
  • Associate's Degree Nursing
  • 3 years Experience in medical/surgical nursing and
  • 1 year Critical care
  • Ability to obtain and interpret information in terms of the patients needs that are age appropriate.
  • Ability to select proper instrumentation/supplies appropriate for age group of patient served.
  • Ability to administer moderate sedation, dysrhythmia recognition, and treatment.
  • Able to work under stressful situations.
  • American Heart Association Basic Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • ACLS – Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • PALS – Pediatric Advanced Life Support – State of Pennsylvania within 90 Days
  • RN – Licensed Registered Nurse—PA – State of Pennsylvania Upon Hire

Preferred Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree Nursing

Physical Demands

Lift and carry 25 lbs. frequent sitting/standing, frequent keyboard use, *patient care providers may be required to perform activities specific to their role including kneeling, bending, squatting and performing CPR.

title: Software Engineer, Risk
description:
Brex: AI-powered Spend Platform

Brex is the AI-powered spend platform that helps companies manage their expenses with integrated corporate cards, banking, global payments, and intuitive software for travel and expenses. Thousands of companies, from startups to enterprises—including DoorDash, Flexport, and Compass—use Brex to control spending, reduce costs, and increase efficiency globally.

Working at Brex means pushing your limits, challenging the status quo, and collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture, empowering you with the tools, resources, and support needed to grow your career.

Our mission is to reimagine financial systems to help growing companies realize their full potential. As the financial OS, we develop software and services that disrupt traditional institutions with innovative products and experiences tailored to our customers' ambitions.

Engineering at Brex

The Engineering team encompasses Data, IT, Security, and Software, responsible for creating innovative products and infrastructure for internal and external users. Our autonomous, collaborative teams are eager to learn, teach, and improve continuously. We aim to build robust, scalable systems that enable Brex's rapid growth and help our customers succeed. Engineers take pride in their work, ownership, and accountability, knowing that today’s software forms the foundation for future systems.

What You’ll Do

We seek passionate individuals to build data-driven risk management systems. You will gain exposure to all aspects of financial crime prevention, from developing customer-facing experiences to collaborating with data scientists to integrate models into production. Strong interpersonal and communication skills are essential, as the role involves interfacing with multiple systems across Brex.

You will work on high-impact projects, maintaining data integrity, ensuring compliance, and driving financial outcomes. This role offers specialized knowledge in risk management and contributes to building trusted financial services while safeguarding customers, the platform, and market integrity.

Where You’ll Work

This role is based in our São Paulo office. You must be willing to work in the office at least two days per week on Wednesdays and Thursdays, starting the week of September 1st, 2025, when our São Paulo office opens.

Responsibilities

  1. Ensure high-quality data for decision systems, using risk vendors and internal models to provide actionable insights for risk management and customer experience improvements.
  2. Develop low-latency decision systems for risk assessment during onboarding, payments, authentication, and in-app processes, leveraging machine learning models.
  3. Build in-product tools to enhance decision systems while making risk management unobtrusive.
  4. Create systems for comprehensive customer due diligence, including KYC, sanctions, adverse media, PEP, and AML monitoring.

Minimum Requirements

  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Kotlin, Go, Python, or Java. Experience with Kotlin is a plus.
  • Foundational knowledge of Machine Learning and experience working with ML-integrated systems, supporting model deployment and feature pipelines.
  • Interest in data-driven systems, solving complex problems, and risk management (prior risk experience is not required).
  • Aptitude for building effective, user-centric tools for internal teams.
  • Strong ownership, motivation to protect customers, and high standards.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to work in the São Paulo office at least two days per week on Wednesdays and Thursdays.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or publications.
  • Experience with low-latency decisioning systems at scale and deploying models.

Note: Job-seekers should be cautious of malicious actors seeking personal data. Brex recruiters will only contact candidates via LinkedIn or email from the @brex.com domain. Beware of outreach from other sources claiming to be from Brex.

title: Store Manager
description:
Job Title: Store Manager

Req#: 00284939-304a-4252-b14a-b11c00ef2443

The Store Manager (SM) is responsible for managing all aspects of the business, with minimal direct supervision from the General Manager (GM), to ensure that Guests are delighted with a fast, friendly, fresh, clean, and in stock shopping experience, teaching and demonstrating core values, and supporting the GM in achieving store goals and initiatives. The SM assists the GM in maintaining a Staffed, Stable & Scheduled environment by providing a consistent Team Member experience through training, coaching, and recognition, while fostering a safety culture by Believing in Zero.

Essential Job Functions (Responsible to)

  1. Drive a safety culture by ensuring a clean, organized, and safe environment for all Team Members and Guests. Ensure proper procedure is followed relating to safety, accidents, and incidents including reporting, investigations, and documentation.
  2. Create a place of welcoming and belonging for our Guests and Team Members.
  3. Oversee the daily execution of the Store Operating System through management of the Game Plans to deliver a consistent Guest/brand experience that enables the store to achieve performance targets and improve financial performance; ability to delegate tasks accordingly and follow up to ensure completion.
  4. Engage and lead company initiatives.
  5. Oversee fresh food production to ensure food safety requirements are always met and par levels are maintained for a craveable and consistent offering, while growing sales and controlling waste.
  6. Develop well trained Team Members by following Thorntons’ training processes as prescribed while demonstrating and teaching our core values.
  7. Support and guide Team Members through career path while holding Team Members to a high standard of execution through coaching and accountability via Thorntons’ Progressive Discipline Process.
  8. Assist GM in facilitating the labor model by ensuring the team is working the schedule to our standard to maintain adequate coverage for all shifts.
  9. Train and empower Team Members to de-escalate Guest service issues.
  10. Communicate with Team Members in a positive manner that motivates and inspires them to act in accordance with Plan to Win strategy.
  11. Use a point-of-sale cash register and other electronic equipment.
  12. Comply with all federal, state, and local inspectors by taking immediate and appropriate action, and communicating and maintaining records of all inspections, certificates, and necessary records.
  13. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Key Relationships

  1. Region Manager
  2. General Manager
  3. Guest Service Representative
  4. Human Resource Manager
  5. Recruiter
  6. Trainer
  7. Auditor

Skills

  1. Demonstrates a commitment to leading by example, considering no tasks as below one’s position.
  2. Contributes to setting work priorities and direction, supporting the team in achieving goals and objectives.
  3. Demonstrates a positive and approachable presence, even during stressful situations.
  4. Recognizes positive performance, celebrates team achievements, and addresses poor performance.
  5. Provides feedback effectively and with empathy.
  6. Collaborates with GM to deliver high-quality Guest service.
  7. Fosters team camaraderie, collaboration, and cohesion.
  8. Proactively identifies potential issues and works with GM to take action to avoid workplace disruptions.
  9. Uses 'active listening' to understand viewpoints of others. Adjusts one's position/view to try and resolve conflict.
  10. Uses analytical skills to identify and solve a variety of business-related problems.
  11. Uses basic arithmetical skills to add, subtract and divide as necessary to complete financial reports, cash, inventory, etc.
  12. Values diversity and recognizes the strengths that individuals from divergent life experiences and backgrounds bring to the team.

Knowledge

  1. Principles and processes for providing Guest Service. This includes Guest needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of Guest satisfaction.
  2. Principles and methods for displaying, promoting, and selling products or services.
  3. Principles and procedures for personnel recruitment, selection, and training.

Experience

Minimum one (1) year of management in retail and/or food and beverage industries.

Equipment/Special Expertise

NA

Required or Preferred Qualifications/Certifications

  1. High School Diploma or GED (required).
  2. Must have reliable transportation.
  3. Valid driver’s license (preferred).
  4. Food Safety and Handling Certifications (This is preferred. If not possessed upon hire, must have the ability to obtain one).

Physical Requirements

  1. Must be able to climb a ladder to clean windows, stock shelves, make price changes, etc.
  2. Daily Standing, Pushing, Pulling, Reaching, Bending, Squatting, Climbing, Walking and Lifting up to 50 lbs.
  3. Occasional Sitting and Driving required.
  4. Exposed to extreme weather conditions and temperatures.
  5. Long periods of standing.
  6. Exposure to gasoline fumes and cleaning products.

Cocinero/a colectividades. ref. sccnr, Belmonte

En Serunion, empresa de restauración colectiva con más de 30 años de experiencia en el sector y líder en el mercado, buscamos incorporar personal con experiencia en colectividades. Ofrecemos la oportunidad de trabajar con nuestros compañeros/as de la división Sanidad-Social, en Belmonte, en centros sanitarios/hospitalarios.

¿Qué estamos buscando?

Buscamos un/a Cocinero/a de colectividades altamente comprometido/a para incorporarse en nuestros centros.

Funciones principales:

  1. Preparar, cocinar y presentar platos de alta calidad según las recetas establecidas.
  2. Gestionar la preparación de los ingredientes, asegurándose de que sean frescos y de alta calidad.
  3. Mantener limpio y organizado el área de trabajo, respetando las normas de higiene y sanidad.
  4. Colaborar con el equipo de cocina para planificar el menú y coordinar los pedidos de abastecimiento.
  5. Supervisar y controlar la calidad de los ingredientes y los platos preparados.
  6. Asegurarse de que todos los platos se presenten de manera atractiva y cumpliendo los tiempos de entrega.
  7. Colaborar con el personal de sala para garantizar un servicio eficiente y satisfacer las necesidades de los clientes.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Contrato temporal para sustitución de vacaciones con posibilidad de continuidad.
  • Horario de trabajo rotativo, de lunes a domingo, con dos días libres, en turnos mañana y/o tarde (de 7/9 – 14/16; 13/15 – 22).
  • Jornada completa.
  • Incorporación inmediata.
  • Salario según convenio colectivo.
  • La oportunidad de formar parte de un equipo apasionado y comprometido que se esfuerza por alcanzar la excelencia en cada detalle.
  • Un ambiente de trabajo inclusivo y diverso, donde se valora la colaboración y el respeto.

Requisitos mínimos:

  • Experiencia comprobada como cocinero/a de al menos 2 años, en un entorno de colectividades o similar.
  • Formación Profesional especializada en cocina o similar.
  • Conocimiento profundo de técnicas culinarias y normas de higiene en el trabajo (APPCC).
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera eficiente y gestionar el propio tiempo en un entorno de trabajo frenético.
  • Vehículo propio y/o disponibilidad para desplazarse al centro de trabajo.
