title: Software Engineer (Trust & Safety Team)
description:
The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a software engineer to join the Trust and Safety Product team. As a software engineer, you will be responsible for building features to keep our communities safe from abuse, harassment, vandalism, and harmful or illicit content. In this role, you will work in a fully-remote, geographically-distributed environment, where we value teamwork and a consensus-oriented approach. You will be writing open source code for collaborative experiences supporting over a billion users at a place that believes we're all more successful when everyone has a good work-life balance.

The Trust and Safety Product team is an interdisciplinary product team developing technology that helps counteract efforts to harm civil discourse on our platforms, the integrity of the content, or other users of our projects. We are seeking a software engineer to join us in this effort to protect our users and our projects.

Currently, we are working on a broad set of tools related to user privacy and protection. Your daily work will include contributing new patches or pull requests for existing features, estimating new work, participating in code reviews, collaborating with a designer, or helping a volunteer engineer get their code shaped up. Because of the sensitive nature of the tools we build, we interact with database administrators, security engineers, and our legal team on a regular basis. Our work goes beyond regular product development into topics such as privacy, security, abuse mitigation, content moderation and legal compliance.

The team is fully staffed with a Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Product Designer, Research Analyst, Data Analyst, Community Liaison, Test Engineers, and several Software Engineers.

Our world is vast and can be complicated, so we consider communication, enthusiasm, and eagerness to learn as important as certificates or degrees.

Responsibilities

  • Developing, testing, and deploying new features, improvements and upgrades to various systems and tools used by administrators and staff.
  • Documenting your contributions to our codebase in our technical documentation and our features’ documentation.
  • Contributing to projects that require handling sensitive data and private information, complying with privacy and security regulations.
  • Providing support in abuse investigations on our platform, helping identify sources and causes of incidents, and proposing ideas to mitigate their impact.
  • Developing expertise in the Trust and Safety area, which includes, security, privacy, abuse mitigation, content moderation and legal compliance.
  • Extending the capabilities of the MediaWiki stack to serve diverse community needs by incorporating possibilities that are offered by new tooling or technical advances.
  • Working across teams to proactively reduce technical debt by refactoring code, updating testing frameworks, and reviewing code from other engineers.

Skills and experience

  • 3+ years of related professional or volunteering experience in software engineering roles, including frontend and backend development, with an emphasis on backend.
  • Experience converting design mockups into functional components, incorporating performance and accessibility into the features using well-documented and readable code.
  • Focused software engineering: writing unit and integration tests, proactively addressing security and code review feedback, and thoughtfully balancing tradeoffs.
  • Strong written communication skills as our collaboration largely happens online, on chats, wikis, documents and tickets.

Qualities that are important to us

  • The desire to make meaningful contributions to knowledge equity, free culture, and open access.
  • An emphasis on communicating clearly in both synchronous and asynchronous channels.
  • The willingness to participate in technical discussions, proposing solutions to technical challenges, participating in code reviews and receiving feedback.
  • An eagerness and curiosity to solve technical problems, trying things out and investigating issues, and supporting the work of others.
  • The skill to effectively work with documentation, writing clearly and concisely, and navigating existing documentation in search for answers.
  • A sensitivity for the problems we are solving, empathy for our users, and the tact to handle the content and information we process.

Additionally, we’d love it if you have this

  • Experience with MediaWiki development or as a contributor to Wikimedia projects.
  • Experience with legacy codebases and/or experience in free/open source software development experience.
  • Experience with online community moderation, vandalism prevention and other Trust and Safety concepts and practices.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$ 88,975 to US$ 139,056 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

Join to apply for the Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.
Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.
Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.
RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.
Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.
Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.
The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.
These teams hire system level C/C++, Golang, Rust and Python developers to work on security-critical, performance-critical and mission-critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Our teams are motivated to have a meaningful impact on modern cloud computing technologies.
Location : we have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.
What you will focus on

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • You have worked on open source virt or container tech
  • You have experience working in the kernel or very low level system
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills We Value
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Benefícios: Convênio com instituições de ensino, Benefício SESC, Vale transporte, Assistência médica, Assistência odontológica, Auxílio alimentação, Fidelize (Clube de Desconto em drogarias)

Responsabilidades da Posição

  • Definir estratégias de relacionamento com o cliente ao longo da jornada, atraindo novos clientes, promovendo engajamento, retenção e crescimento de receita usando ferramentas de CRM, automações e campanhas segmentadas.
  • Construir jornadas personalizadas e estratégias de fidelização, através da análise de dados de clientes para identificar padrões, tendências e insights relevantes.
  • Gerenciar a base de dados de clientes, garantindo sua qualidade, segmentação e insights acionáveis, planejando e executando campanhas de CRM focadas em aquisição, ativação, retenção e reativação.
  • Criar segmentos de clientes com base em dados demográficos, comportamentais e de compra, para personalizar campanhas e comunicações.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos de comunicação e campanhas automatizadas (e-mail, SMS, push, WhatsApp, entre outros), criando conteúdo personalizado e relevante para cada segmento.
  • Realizar testes A/B, análises de performance e gerar relatórios para melhorias contínuas.
  • Administrar ferramentas de CRM e automação, como RD Station, HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics, entre outras.
  • Estabelecer KPIs para medir o sucesso das ações de CRM, como taxa de abertura, clique, conversão, retenção e valor vitalício, propondo ações de otimização e apresentando relatórios e insights.
  • Avaliar o ROI das campanhas de CRM, otimizando orçamento e recursos.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Comunicação, Trade, Comercial e Tecnologia para alinhar estratégias e garantir consistência nas ações.
  • Revisar processos e rotinas existentes, garantindo eficiência operacional, minimizando erros, maximizando produtividade e escalabilidade.

Requisitos obrigatórios para a posição

  • Superior completo.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência na área.
  • Domínio de estratégias, execução de CRM, automação de marketing e construção de jornadas de clientes personalizadas.
  • Habilidade com segmentação de base de dados e análise de métricas de campanha.
  • Visão estratégica, perfil analítico, proatividade e orientação a resultados.

Sobre a empresa

Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca com mais de 45 anos, que coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo. Com mais de 135 lojas físicas e mais de 4.900 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios e Volta Redonda. Além disso, nossos canais digitais atuam em mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil.

Nosso propósito? Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Saúde vai além de medicamentos: é qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.

Fundada em 2014, a Hospinova é uma empresa do Grupo Venancio focada no mercado hospitalar e distribuição farmacêutica, garantindo serviço especializado e eficiente. Contamos com três centros de distribuição no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.

Nos destacamos pelo nosso espírito carioca, acolhimento, inovação, valorização do capital humano, ética, transparência e simplicidade. Cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importa.

Até 2025, planejamos inaugurar mais 23 lojas e expandir nossa presença, sempre oferecendo atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.

Se você compartilha nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha crescer conosco!

Nossas tecnologias líderes e nossa capacidade de aplicá-las com segurança e criar valor de forma eficaz para nossos clientes e acionistas.

Como Mandrilhador I, você será responsável por:

TAREFAS DIÁRIAS

  • Realizar reunião de pré-trabalho, preenchendo formulário e check list, fazendo a leitura dos procedimentos e documentos para realização da operação, com o objetivo de identificar se os itens necessários para a execução da atividade estão disponíveis.
  • Realizar movimentação de peça para a máquina, utilizando ponte rolante, talha, cintas, olhais, correntes e manilhas, seguindo os procedimentos de segurança e isolando a área.
  • Preparar peça na máquina - fixar a peça na mesa da mandrilhadora de acordo com as informações fornecidas pela Engenharia Industrial (Doc.: folha de preparação), garantindo que a peça não se mova durante a operação de usinagem.
  • Realizar o isolamento da área, seguindo os procedimentos de segurança.
  • Realizar captura dos pontos zeros inserindo a captura dos pontos zeros conforme informado pela Engenharia industrial, utilizando relógios apalpadores, comparadores ou cabeça Probe. Essa atividade é feita para garantir que as coordenadas do programa CNC estejam de acordo com o posicionamento geométrico da peça.
  • Realizar zeramento de ferramentas - encostar a ferramenta na peça ou com bloco padrão entre a peça e a ferramenta para realizar o zeramento. Inserir os valores na máquina de forma manual com o objetivo de determinar o ponto de início (ponto zero) da ferramenta com relação a peça, para realizar a usinagem.
  • Realizar operação de usinagem em mandrilhadoras Wotans - a usinagem das peças é feita conforme sequência pré-definida no programa CNC. Serão realizadas operações de fresamento, furação, rosqueamento e usinagem de perfis internos com ferramentas especiais, transformando a matéria prima nas dimensões especificadas no projeto do cliente.
  • Realizar inspeções das medidas usinadas fazendo uso de instrumentos de medição como: paquímetro, micrômetro, súbito, tubular, ball-gage, relógios entre outros, assegurando que não sejam fabricadas peças com dimensões que estejam fora da especificação no projeto do cliente.
  • Realizar usinagem utilizando cabeçotes angulares - deve-se fixar cabeçote angular na máquina, inclinando de acordo com as determinações da Engenharia Industrial, para realizar operações em ângulos, graus, em diâmetros internos de difícil acesso.

Para ter sucesso nessa função, você precisa:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Curso de Fresador CNC
  • Experiência prévia na função
  • Controle dimensional
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnicos
  • Conhecimentos de Métodos e Processos de Usinagem
  • Identificar e registrar findings de segurança
  • Identificar e sugerir melhorias do processo
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos
  • Conhecimentos em Tolerâncias Geométricas (GD&T)

  • Manuseio e transporte de peças com ponte rolante
  • Conhecimentos básicos nos softwares: Oracle, Epims, Gensuite, Manusis
  • Conhecimento em ferramental e consumíveis para os processos produtivos existentes
  • Treinamento LEAN Básico
  • Programação CNC
  • Cursos na área de Metalurgia.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas
  • Conhecimento de Produto de Óleo e Gás.

Reconhecemos que todos são diferentes e que a maneira pela qual as pessoas querem trabalhar e dar o melhor de si também é diferente para cada pessoa.

Nosso pessoal está no centro do que fazemos na Baker Hughes. Sabemos que somos melhores quando todo o nosso pessoal está desenvolvido, engajado e capaz de trabalhar com toda a sua autenticidade. Nossas invenções revolucionaram a energia por mais de um século. Mas, para continuar amanhã, sabemos que temos que ultrapassar os limites hoje. Priorizamos recompensar aqueles que abraçam a mudança com um pacote que reflete o quanto valorizamos sua contribuição. Junte-se a nós e você pode esperar:

Com operações em mais de 120 países, oferecemos melhores soluções para nossos clientes e oportunidades mais ricas para nosso pessoal. Como parceiro líder do setor de energia, estamos comprometidos em atingir zero emissões líquidas de carbono até 2050 e estamos sempre procurando as pessoas certas para nos ajudar a chegar lá. Pessoas que são tão apaixonadas quanto nós por tornar a energia mais segura, mais limpa e mais eficiente.

Job Description

We are looking for a Data Engineer to design and implement large-scale, real-time data architectures that power AI, predictive maintenance, and industrial automation in mission-critical environments. How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

  • Build and optimize secure, scalable data lakes and ETL pipelines for mining, oil & gas, and heavy industry applications.
  • Implement event-driven architectures and data transformation workflows for AI-powered automation.
  • Ensure data governance, security, and compliance with industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443, ISO 27001, GDPR).
  • Work with AI engineers, cloud architects, and automation teams to enable real-time AI decision-making.
  • Optimize time-series data processing using TimescaleDB, InfluxDB, or OpenTSDB.
  • Deploy cloud-based data solutions with AWS Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub, Snowflake, or Grafana.
  • Monitor data pipeline performance with modern observability frameworks (e.g., Prometheus), ensuring fault tolerance, scalability, versioning, and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with industrial automation and IoT teams to integrate edge-to-cloud data flows.

Key Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in real-time data engineering, cloud computing, or industrial IoT.
  • Strong expertise in data streaming, event-driven processing, and distributed computing frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Big Data technologies like Kafka, Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, or similar.
  • Deep knowledge of ETL design, data warehousing, and real-time analytics.
  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, including TimescaleDB, InfluxDB, Cassandra, or MongoDB.
  • Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java for data processing and automation.
  • Understanding of IoT protocols (MQTT, OPC-UA, Modbus) and industrial data standards.
  • Familiarity with DevOps and MLOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines for data workflows.
  • Knowledge of cloud-native data solutions (AWS Kinesis, Google Pub/Sub, Azure Event Hub).
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms like Apache Airflow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in mining, oil & gas, or large-scale industrial automation projects.
  • Knowledge of machine learning model deployment in real-time environments.
  • Understanding of GIS data processing, geospatial analytics, and digital twin integrations.
  • Experience with cybersecurity frameworks for industrial data environments.

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving skills, capable of optimizing large-scale data architectures.
  • Ability to collaborate across teams, including AI, cloud, and industrial operations.
  • Effective communication skills for translating technical data insights into business strategies.
  • Passion for real-time data processing, AI-driven automation, and industrial innovation.

Responsável por analisar e contribuir com o Planejamento e Controle comercial do Grupo Pereira, visando

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Conduzir os processos de suporte à equipe comercial na execução e análise de estratégias da área,
    através da elaboração e acompanhamento de KPIs (Key Performance Indicator) e demonstrativos de

    análises de contratos junto a fornecedores;
  5. Favorecer a recuperação de verbas contratuais, por meio da apuração de acordos junto ao fornecedor;
  6. Contribuir com o planejamento de renegociação de contatos, através de cronograma definido em

About Grupo Pereira

Fundado em 1962, na cidade de Itajaí, em Santa Catarina, o Grupo Pereira tem o propósito de "Ser um bom lugar para passar a vida, nos transformando, transformando as pessoas e o ambiente ao nosso redor".

Com 20 mil funcionários e 800 representantes comerciais autônomos nos Estados de Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Goiás, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, São Paulo e no Distrito Federal, o Grupo Pereira tem mais 125 unidades de negócio, sendo 31 lojas do Comper (rede de supermercados), 60 lojas do Fort Atacadista (atacarejo), 3 filiais do Atacado Bate Forte (atacadista de distribuição), 1 Broker (distribuidora da rede Nestlé), 23 lojas SempreFort (varejo farmacêutico), 5 lojas Pera Turismo (Agência de Viagens) e 2 postos de combustíveis.

Com a missão de oferecer uma experiência de compra positiva por meio de excelência no relacionamento com clientes, fornecedores e funcionários, o Grupo Pereira colabora com a sociedade por meio de diferentes programas socioambientais.

description:

Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

But that’s just the beginning:

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about fintech and making a mark, this is your chance to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, push boundaries, and set new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as industry leaders.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are eager to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

In this role, you will need a deep understanding of technology, excellent stakeholder management, and the ability to guide cross-functional teams through the product lifecycle. You’ll collaborate with developers, designers, and leadership to define product roadmaps, align requirements, and launch new products. This is a great opportunity for experienced professionals to contribute to impactful product launches in a dynamic environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation to post-launch analysis, including defining user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog management, and workflows for development teams.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable requirements. Evaluate technical solutions and prioritize features based on feasibility, impact, and customer value.

  • Conduct market research and customer discovery to understand the value proposition of our products.

  • Collaborate with developers, designers, and stakeholders to gather requirements, validate solutions, and ensure successful delivery.

  • Ensure timely delivery of features meeting quality standards; organize testing and feedback processes.


  • Minimum of 5+ years of product management experience, including at least 3 years in a technical product management role.

  • Excellent communication skills for bridging technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proficiency in agile methodologies and tools like Jira, Asana, etc.

  • Strong understanding of microservices, P2P systems, JavaScript.

  • Strong organizational skills to manage multiple priorities remotely.

  • Experience defining, tracking, and reporting on product KPIs; familiarity with A/B testing or similar methods is a plus.

  • Experience leading AI and P2P projects is advantageous.

  • Hands-on development experience with JavaScript frameworks like Node.js, React, or Angular is a plus.

Why Islands?

title: Analista Comercial - E-commerce
description:
Somos o Grupo Webcontinental, a Sua Melhor Escolha!

A Webcontinental foi fundada em 2007 com o objetivo de transformar a vida das pessoas. O Grupo atua como e-commerce, marketplace, e possui a sua indústria própria através de duas verticais - Gallant Importação e Gallant Indústria.

Ao longo dos 16 anos de atuação no mercado, a Webcontinental ampliou suas áreas de atuação para diferentes segmentos, e conta com uma moderna estrutura física e uma logística eficiente, permitindo sua atuação em todo o território nacional.

A sede administrativa está localizada em Porto Alegre - RS, além dos três centros de distribuição (Viana - ES, Cariacica - ES e Navegantes - SC), e um escritório em São Paulo.

COMPROMISSO E CERTIFICAÇÃO:

A Webcontinental possui diversas certificações fundamentais para a construção de credibilidade no e-commerce, como o selo Ebit, que reafirma o compromisso ético da empresa em levar segurança ao processo de compra.

Além disso, algumas premiações coroaram a Web como empresa consolidada no meio, como o Prêmio ABComm de Inovação Digital 2024, que pela segunda vez consecutiva elegeu a Webcontinental como Melhor Marketplace do Brasil.

São 4 mil sellers cadastrados na Webcontinental Marketplace, que contam com um catálogo de 40 categorias, totalizando mais de 4 milhões de produtos cadastrados, vendidos através do site e de aplicativo próprio.

A missão da Webcontinental é proporcionar aos clientes um serviço de qualidade e agilidade, simplificando suas vidas.

Descrição da Vaga: Analista Comercial de Categoria

Como Analista Comercial de Categoria, você fará parte do time com um profundo conhecimento do mercado e das dinâmicas do setor e, principalmente, das categorias em que atua. Este profissional será responsável por:

  1. Analisar dados de venda do mercado e do nosso canal.
  2. Planejar e executar estratégias para potencializar e desenvolver os resultados por categoria dentro do site, garantindo o atingimento de metas de GMV e margem estabelecidas pela gestão.
  3. Atuar estrategicamente na negociação direta com os Sellers parceiros, elaborando campanhas comerciais e controlando a precificação.
  4. Selecionar e gerenciar os produtos das suas respectivas categorias que serão destacados em nosso site.
  5. Criar a curva ABC das categorias, identificando potenciais e oportunidades.
  6. Negociar Mix de produtos por categoria com a equipe interna de sellers, buscando melhor competitividade e rentabilidade para o e-commerce.
  7. Realizar análise e pesquisa de mercado diária para identificação de oportunidades e otimização necessária nas ações em andamento.
  8. Monitorar preço, estoque, frete e prazos de entrega para os produtos potenciais das categorias.
  9. Preencher diariamente planilhas de resultados, apontando desvios e atuando em planos de ação.
  10. Colaborar com o time de e-commerce na execução de campanhas de marketing promocional do site.
  11. Trabalhar as metas de venda válida e margem/comissão por categoria, estabelecidas pela equipe de gestão.
  12. Desenvolver estratégias e ações para alcançar as metas estabelecidas por categoria e canal como um todo.
  13. Preparar e apresentar relatórios e análises de resultados da categoria.
  14. Atuar junto ao time de televendas na elaboração e aprovação de orçamentos.
  15. Garantir exposição no site para os produtos com melhor competitividade e potencial de resultado da categoria.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

Essa posição é para atuar presencilmente em Contagem, MG.

Who will you be working with?
In this role, you will work with a global team.

How will you make a difference?

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer to work on the design and implementation of technical solutions for our cloud infrastructure.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience working in cloud engineering or a related field.
  • Professional experience working with AWS.
  • Advanced in scripting languages such as Python or Bash and a comprehension of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps methodologies.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and experience of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Gitlab, and CloudFormation.
  • In-depth Understanding of networking, security, and cloud industry standards and protocols.
  • Experienced at utilizing containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experienced in utilizing monitoring technologies such as CloudWatch, Prometheus, or Grafana.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and communicate solutions effectively.
  • Advanced in working with multi-cloud settings.
  • Understanding of serverless computing and microservices architecture.
  • Ability to effectively communicate in English.
  • Cloud certifications such as AWS, Azure, or GCP are strongly preferred.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Develop and execute cloud-based solutions on platforms such as AWS and Azure in line with the company’s commercial and technical needs.
  • Utilize Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and CloudFormation to automate the process of deploying and managing cloud services.
  • Oversee, uphold, and enhance cloud environments to ensure availability, performance, and security.
  • Enforce and sustain security protocols throughout the cloud architecture, including identity management, encryption, and adherence to industry standards.
  • Contribute to the optimization of cloud performance and cost management.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to support cloud-based applications and promptly address any arising concerns.
  • Generate and uphold documentation for cloud infrastructure, processes, and procedures to ensure proper knowledge transfer within the team.

Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Assistência Odontológica extensível a dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Participação nos lucros e resultados.
  • Previdência Privada.
  • Política de Alimentação de acordo com localidade.
  • Política de Estacionamento ou Vale Transporte.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Programa de Assistência ao Empregado: orientação psicológica, jurídica, financeira e assistência social.
  • Headspace – aplicativo focado em saúde mental.
  • Cartão ou Cesta de Natal aos funcionários de acordo com localidade.
  • Presente de Natal para filhos de até 11 anos de idade.
  • Licença maternidade estendida.
  • Programa para Gestantes e Bebês.
  • Política de incentivo a idiomas.
  • Programas de Mentoria e acesso a plataforma de treinamento.

Who are we?

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital-rail-and-transit ecosystems.

Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!

Our Commitment to Embrace Diversity:

Wabtec is a global company that invests not just in our products, but also our people by embracing diversity and inclusion. We care about our relationships with our employees and take pride in celebrating the variety of experiences, expertise, and backgrounds that bring us together. At Wabtec, we aspire to create a place where we all belong and where diversity is welcomed and appreciated.

To fulfill that commitment, we rely on a culture of leadership, diversity, and inclusion. We aim to employ the world’s brightest minds to help us create a limitless source of ideas and opportunities. We have created a space where everyone is given the opportunity to contribute based on their individual experiences and perspectives and recognize that these differences and diverse perspectives make us better.

We believe in hiring talented people of varied backgrounds, experiences, and styles… People like you! Wabtec Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or protected Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Senior Payment Success Analyst
description:
Company Overview

If you see technology as a way to smooth your path in life, our team does too: Your Path, Our Journey.

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

Team Overview

The Financial Institution Business Development (FIBD) team focused on payments plays a critical role in shaping and managing strategic partnerships with banks, payment providers, and other financial stakeholders. Our mission is to enhance the company’s payment capabilities, ensuring a seamless, secure, and efficient transaction experience for our customers across multiple business units, including ride-hailing and 99Pay.

As part of the online payments vertical, we work closely with acquirers, issuers, card schemes, and alternative payment providers to optimize payment operations, expand local payment acceptance, reduce costs, and drive innovation. Collaboration with internal stakeholders—such as risk, compliance, legal, treasury, and product teams—is key to ensuring regulatory compliance and continuous improvement of our payment ecosystem.

By joining our team, you’ll be at the forefront of the rapidly evolving payments landscape, working on high-impact projects that drive financial efficiency and enhance the user experience.

Role Responsibilities

  1. Monitoring and ensuring the seamless operation of payment methods, including cards, PIX, and alternative payment solutions.
  2. Analyzing payment data and trends to identify inefficiencies, propose improvements, and enhance user experience.
  3. Managing relationships with payment service providers, acquirers, banks, and card schemes to ensure operational excellence.
  4. Collaborating with risk, IT, compliance, legal, and treasury teams to streamline workflows and mitigate payment-related risks.
  5. Ensuring regulatory compliance, staying up to date with payment industry standards and local regulations.
  6. Supporting payment-related projects, including the integration of new payment methods and technology enhancements.

Role Qualifications

  1. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  2. At least 2 years of experience in payments, fintech, financial operations, or related fields.
  3. A strong analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and propose actionable insights.
  4. Excellent communication skills, both with internal teams and external partners (proficiency in English is mandatory).
  5. A flexible and proactive attitude, comfortable working across time zones, especially in Brazil and China.
  6. A keen interest in learning and growing in the payments industry, rather than relying solely on prior experience. This is a hands-on role with significant learning opportunities.

If you are passionate about payments and excited about making an impact in a global tech company, we’d love to hear from you!

EEO Statement

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.
Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

title: Quality Control Lab. Lead
description:
Direct Reports: number and roles: current 4 QC Analysts

Contract Type: Permanent

About Us

We are a team of passionate individuals, developing ground-breaking biological technologies designed to sustainably and safely control insects that transmit diseases and destroy crops. We do this work to improve lives and livelihoods around the world in the face of the growing threats that insects pose to human health and the global food supply. Oxitec is about people and is in service to people.

We are strongly committed to a set of values, principles, and behaviours that foster a culture of trust, respect, creativity, and accountability. We seek talented people who are deeply committed to our mission, values, and principles, and thrive in start-up like environments. Learn more here about our mission, values, and principles.

Purpose of the Job

Oxitec is seeking a highly motivated and dedicated Quality Control Lab Lead to join our team in Brazil. This position will support all activities of quality control of an innovative insect technology. We are looking for a passionate candidate who will be directly involved with the quality control analysis of samples collected from entomological production, supporting the development of new quality methodologies, laboratory routines, data support, production incoming goods analysis, and supporting the quality assurance area to elaborate and/or review quality documentation. This position will work with other staff members to ensure procedures and products adhere to established quality standards. Considerable experience with planning and coordination of activities is required; knowledge about entomology is interesting, but the willingness to learn and the dream of changing the world for the better is essential.

Responsibilities

  1. Responsible for QC laboratory routine scheduling and resource planning.
  2. Lead the QC Analyst team, guiding and ensuring that activities are executed within time, quality, and safety standards.
  3. Perform data analysis, checking whether results are within expected standards and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  4. Prepare management reports and update internal KPIs.
  5. Participate in technical processes and activities in the QC laboratory, supporting lab routine and ensuring timely delivery of results.

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As a Field Technician, you will engage with many of Rockwell Automation's customers across a variety of industries. Your mission is to support our customers in assessing their control system assets and working hands-on to ensure that systems are maintained and functioning properly.

You will be focused on on-site technical services that may include commissioning, startup, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Control Systems (PLC/Motion/Drives) in several applications. You will provide on-site field support to engineering installation and may be an embedded resource for customer or distributor.

Field Technicians help maintain our reputation for excellent customer service and will collaborate with sales team members to ensure any commercial challenges are resolved quickly.

Your Responsibilities:

  • You will provide on-site support and troubleshooting of product-level issues on Rockwell Automation technologies (PLCs, HMI, VFDs and other motor control components).
  • You will perform preventative maintenance activities on automation assets.
  • You will support customers to maintain control system health (ex: firmware updates, OS patching, and program backups).
  • You will assess and document customer automation installed base and network infrastructure.
  • You will support customers, contractors, and RA project teams with installation, check-out, testing, and startup of RA products and systems (ex: I/O terminations and check-out, network cable setup, hardware configuration).
  • You will support Engineers with small project execution involving PLC and HMI migrations/conversions.
  • You may participate in remote technical support activities for customers when not engaged in on-site activities.
  • You may serve as a long-term embedded resource at customers requiring on-site support.

The Essentials - You Will Have:

  • High School Diploma or Technical Graduation in Electrical, Automation, or related field.
  • Ability to travel 90% often on short notice, and occasionally requiring availability during off-hours, weekends, and holidays.
  • A valid driver's license.

The Preferred - You Might Also Have:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of experience.
  • Knowledge of Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley control system platforms, including PowerFlex Drives, Logix Controllers, Kinetix Servo Drives, and motors.
  • Understanding of AC/DC power circuits, pushbuttons, circuit breakers, power supplies, overloads, contactors, relays, motors, VFDs, and PLCs.
  • Customer relationship development and management skills.
  • Demonstrated experience working as part of a project team and partnering across cultural boundaries.

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.
  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
  • Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program.
  • On-demand digital course library for professional development.

Reporting to: Territory Service Manager

Work Model: Field-based Role

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. title: Analista de Marketing de Influência PL. [Modelo Híbrido - São Paulo]
description:
Job description

Quem somos:

Na Wake Creators unimos influenciadores, tecnologia e audiência. Possuímos tecnologia líder em marketing de influência baseada em mais de 10 anos de coleta de dados e oferecemos a melhor audiência para as marcas, com transparência de ponta a ponta. Hoje somos a maior plataforma de Creators Economy do país, executando campanhas nacionais e internacionais para marcas como Ambev, Spotify, Unilever, Bradesco, Natura, Magazine Luiza, Samsung, 99, Ifood, L'Oreal, entre outras.

Transformar o e-commerce em uma experiência revolucionária é o maior desafio da Wake. Somos obcecados em elevar as empresas para novos patamares e impulsionar a mudança, com um impacto real na forma como as pessoas compram e vendem, seja no online ou físico.

Quer fazer parte desse time revolucionário do cenário do marketing de influência?

Quer ser um Waker?

Buscamos pessoas resolutivas, fomentadoras e criativas, que tenham persistência, curiosidade, paixão, honestidade e senso de trabalho em equipe para inovar e desenvolver negócios que transformem o mundo, independente do gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência. Além disso, que estejam alinhadas com nossas condutas e valores: colaboração, determinação, integridade, evolução e equidade.

#VemSerWaker

#A(R)EvoluçãoComeçaAqui


Main responsibilities

O trabalho no time de (Marketing de Influência)

O time é responsável por garantir que os clientes da empresa alcancem seus objetivos e obtenham o máximo valor de nossas soluções voltadas para o marketing de influência. Nossa missão é criar uma experiência excepcional para os clientes, promovendo a satisfação e a retenção, além de identificar oportunidades de crescimento e expansão dentro da base de clientes.

Como será seu dia a dia:

Onboarding de Clientes:

  • Realizar o kick off de campanhas de novos clientes, garantindo que eles compreendam como utilizar nossos serviços e plataforma de maneira eficaz;
  • Apresentar a plataforma e alinhar os processos para operação de campanhas de marketing de influência.

Gestão de Relacionamentos:

  • Manter contato regular com os clientes, reportando o progresso das campanhas e atuando em conjunto com a coordenação na resolução de possíveis problemas;
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos de longo prazo com os clientes, atuando como ponto de contato principal para consultas e suporte.

Operação de campanhas:

  • Executar campanhas de marketing de influência, incluindo seleção de influenciadores, negociação, recrutamento, acompanhamento e finalização;
  • Dar suporte na análise de campanhas, garantindo que os clientes estejam atingindo suas metas;
  • Oferecer insights e recomendações baseadas em dados para melhorar campanhas e estratégias de marketing;
  • Garantir que os clientes de sua responsabilidade estejam tendo o SLA de resposta e de resolução adequados;
  • Fazer a gestão de cronograma de campanhas, garantindo a execução no prazo alinhado com o cliente;
  • Ser responsável pelo orçamento das campanhas, garantindo que a operação esteja dentro da verba estipulada;
  • Identificar e propor oportunidades de upsell e cross-sell para clientes, ajudando a expandir o uso de nossos serviços;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe de vendas para desenvolver estratégias de retenção e expansão de contas;
  • Coletar feedback dos clientes e trabalhar com equipes internas para implementar melhorias nos serviços e produtos.

Requirements and skills

  • Comunicação : Habilidade para comunicar-se de forma clara e eficaz, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito;
  • Orientação para o Cliente : Paixão por ajudar os clientes e compromisso em garantir sua satisfação;
  • Capacidade Analítica : Habilidade para analisar dados e métricas de desempenho, identificando tendências e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Resolução de Problemas : Capacidade de lidar com situações desafiadoras de maneira calma e eficiente;
  • Trabalho em Equipe : Habilidade para colaborar com diferentes departamentos e funções dentro da empresa;
  • Proatividade : Ser proativo em identificar problemas e sugerir soluções antes que se tornem críticas;
  • Organização : Capacidade de operar múltiplas tarefas e projetos simultaneamente, mantendo o foco nos prazos e na qualidade do trabalho;
  • Conhecimento em Excel : Habilidade para utilizar o Excel de maneira eficaz;
  • Jogo de Cintura : Habilidade para mediar situações entre clientes e influenciadores, garantindo o alinhamento das expectativas e o sucesso das campanhas;
  • Conhecimento em marketing de influência : Ser heavy user das redes sociais e antenado nas principais tendências.

Ficaremos ainda mais encantados se você tiver (diferenciais):

title: Sr. Tax Analyst - ICMS, ICMS-ST
description:
Are you ready to take on complex tax challenges at a global leader in technology, commerce, and innovation?
We're hiring a Senior Tax Analyst! If you're looking for a new opportunity, check out this open role on our Tax Compliance team in Brazil.

Key job responsibilities:

  1. Providing effective support in tax closing activities regarding ICMS, ICMS-ST, and submission of ancillary obligations ("obrigações acessórias") such as CIAP, Gia, Sped-Fiscal, Gis, EC, Inventory, Bloco K, EFD Contribuições, among others;
  2. Controlling tax credit balances to be offset (accumulated balance), as well as the control of PERDCOMPS;
  3. Responsible for coordinating and, when required, performing tax compliance activities, ensuring adherence to company deadlines and internal controls;
  4. Work with other stakeholders, including Accounting, to prepare calculation records, reconcile tax returns, and ensure accuracy;
  5. Active participation in company projects, resolving doubts and proposing tax paths and solutions.

It is a plus for the position to:
  1. Prepare monthly / periodic indirect tax filings for Amazon and related subsidiaries, in LATAM and Caribbean region, including but not limited to VAT, Turnover Taxes, ICA tax, and other similar taxes;
  2. Develop and implement process improvements across LATAM and Caribbean Indirect Tax compliance;
  3. Prepare basic reconciliation of transaction tax general ledger accounts.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and hires qualified individuals regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, age or disability.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
- Experience working in a large public accounting firm or multi-national corporate tax department
- +5 years of relevant tax experience in a corporate environment, public accounting firm or major law firm.
- Significant experience in Brazil (ICMS, ICMS ST) and international taxation concepts. Also, it is a plus to have an understanding of or practical experience related to digital, cloud, and marketplace businesses.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex tax laws in a business setting, both in Portuguese and English.
- Proficiency in English, including the ability to communicate, participate in daily video conferences, write, and understand emails. Spanish proficiency is a plus for the position.
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel is required (you'll be tested on your Excel skills)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 4+ years of maintaining and operating transaction tax calculation software (e.g. Vertex) experience

title: PESSOA COORDENADOR CURSO II DE FISIOTERAPIA
description:
Job description

AQUI SUA CARREIRA COMEÇA GRANDE.

VENHA SER UMA PESSOA COORDENADOR CURSO II DE FISIOTERAPIA NA ESTÁCIO.

Temos um projeto grandioso e que requer um time com disposição para pensar de forma original, disruptiva, e com objetivo de resolver as grandes questões de hoje na educação: acesso, tecnologia, customização e o sucesso dos nossos alunos.

Somos uma companhia cheia de energia, que já nasceu gigante e com resultados extraordinários.

Venha fazer parte desse time!

VENHA TRANSFORMAR VIDAS. INCLUSIVE A SUA.


Main responsibilities

Os principais desafios como Pessoa Coordenador de Curso II de Fisioterapia são:

  1. Ajudar os nossos alunos em suas metas, por meio de uma boa relação, fazendo-os perceber que devem procurá-lo sempre que for preciso para resolver problemas referentes ao seu dia a dia na faculdade, como escolha de disciplinas, problemas ou queixas com os docentes, ou demais pedidos e demandas que venham a surgir, colaborando para que nossos alunos possam atingir seus objetivos educacionais e de carreira, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a solidificação da nossa marca;
  2. Trabalhar em equipe com os professores, com empenho e foco, visando a uma contínua melhora no processo de ensino, proporcionando aos professores toda a orientação necessária para que possam cumprir as metas e os prazos acadêmicos, estimulando-os a participar dos programas de capacitação da instituição, proporcionando-lhes um diferencial, que será percebido por nossos alunos, contribuindo, dessa forma, para a melhoria constante da qualidade acadêmica. Deverá, ainda, realizar, em parceria com o Coordenador Acadêmico de Curso, a contratação e demissões de professores, avaliação do desempenho, dando feedback ao professor com franqueza suficiente para auxiliá-lo no seu desenvolvimento profissional;

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Acompanhar indicadores de segurança patrimonial e gerenciar projetos de segurança patrimonial.

  • Criar relatórios de investigação e contar com interface do time de monitoramento e fornecedores de segurança patrimonial.
  • Reportar aos stakeholders os principais avanços do portfólio e impactos estimados nos projetos de segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa em logística, administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Contar com experiência anterior em gestão de processos.
  • Conter conhecimento em análise de indicadores e em tecnologias de monitoramento (CFTV).
  • Ter conhecimento em Excel e Google Sheets.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial em Barueri/SP, de Segunda a Sexta-feira das 21:00hs às 06:48hs.


Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

Analista Pleno de Prevenção de Perdas para Mercado Envios

Sudeste, Brazil • Barueri, State of São Paulo, Brazil

1 item added

Job Description

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

No Mercado Envios administramos o estoque de nossos vendedores e entregamos os produtos aos nossos compradores, melhorando sua experiência em nossa plataforma. Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Faça parte da equipe que está liderando a logística na América Latina, oferecendo soluções customizadas de classe mundial e integrando carriers locais e regionais, através de um comércio que não reconhece fronteiras.

Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.


Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:

  • Acompanhar indicadores de segurança patrimonial e gerenciar projetos de segurança patrimonial.
  • Gerenciar fluxos operacionais relacionados a área patrimonial, além de acompanhamento e monitoramento das atividades realizadas pelos vigilantes.
  • Criar, gerenciar e acompanhar os controles de acesso do condomínio e operação, realizando avaliação de risco do local.
  • Criar relatórios de investigação e contar com interface do time de monitoramento e fornecedores de segurança patrimonial.
  • Reportar aos stakeholders os principais avanços do portfólio e impactos estimados nos projetos de segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Possuir formação superior completa em logística, administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Contar com experiência anterior em gestão de processos.
  • Conter conhecimento em análise de indicadores e em tecnologias de monitoramento (CFTV).
  • Ter conhecimento em Excel e Google Sheets.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial em Barueri/SP, de Segunda a Sexta-feira das 21:00hs às 06:48hs.


Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)

O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

VR ou Refeitório, VA para ajudar nas compras do mercado e, no final do ano, VA adicional;

description:
Nu was born in 2013 with the mission to fight complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. We are one of the world’s largest digital banking platforms, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia.

Our Procurement team

Our purpose is to support, influence and challenge Nubank business decisions by delivering value to the end-to-end sourcing processes through long-term & sustainable partnerships, all executed with efficient, agile and innovative technologies.

The Procurement team's BHAG (Big Hairy Audacious Goal) is to be the best and least bureaucratic Procurement area in the technology segment by promoting cost efficiency through strategic long-term & sustainable partnerships with the highest skilled, diverse and engaged team.

You will be responsible for

  • Lead the creation and establishment of a comprehensive Procurement KPI tracking framework.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for process and efficiency improvements through data analysis and Procurement/BI tools.
  • Contribute to financial and Procurement data reporting, ensuring the delivery of reliable and timely information for various stakeholders.
  • Engage with stakeholders (such as Finance, FP&A, Engineering, Risk and other teams) across the organization to map data sources and ensure accurate data representation.
  • Develop and maintain datasets in BI and Data tools, enabling scalable data manipulation and analysis.
  • Design and implement dashboards to provide actionable insights and support decision-making for the Procurement team.
  • Utilize SQL and other programming languages (e.g., Python) to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets for optimized financial and procurement strategies.

We are looking for a person who has

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Scala and/or Python for data analysis and experience with data visualization tools
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams as well as practical knowledge on documentation techniques, and project management tools.
  • Experience with financial technologies and a strong passion for business, economy, finance, and technology.
  • Understanding of financial statements and accounting data structure.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and collaborative environment.
  • Familiarity with sourcing and procurement processes is a plus.
  • Language: Advanced proficiency in English; Spanish is a beneficial addition.

Our Nu Way of Working

Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or two weeks of remote work, one will be at the office.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seeks to empower. That's why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring neither of them represents a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent.

title: RODOVIA l OPERADOR(A) DE PEDÁGIO
description:
Job description

Quer mover a sua carreira na CCR?

O Grupo CCR é o lugar certo para o seu talento, onde você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que melhora a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades.


Main responsibilities

  • Realizar a liberação das faixas automáticas;
  • Identificar, classificar e cobrar as tarifas de pedágio, de acordo com as classes dos veículos;
  • Registrar o recebimento das tarifas de pedágio dos veículos;
  • Informar ao líder imediato as ocorrências surgidas em sua cabine para que possamos prosperar, criando valor sustentável para a sociedade.

Requirements and skills

O que esperamos de você:

Ensino Fundamental Completo;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar no turno 2X3 - 2X2 - 2X3 das 06 às 18h ou 18h às 06h;

Moradia em Sorocaba/SP.


Additional information

Ao entrar para o nosso time integrado, você fará parte de uma empresa presente em 13 estados do país e que movimenta milhares de pessoas diariamente ao oferecer mobilidade de forma íntegra e que gera impacto positivo na sociedade. Aqui, você encontrará diversos benefícios para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento e dar mais movimento para a sua carreira.

Confira os benefícios que oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica-Hospitalar;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Adicional Noturno;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento no local;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Licença Estendida: maternidade 180 dias e paternidade 20 dias;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Day off aniversário (Folga);
  • PLR (Participação nos lucros ou resultados);
  • Política de flexibilidade na jornada de trabalho, e muito mais!

Quer melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade e contribuir para chegarmos ainda mais longe? Então, traga o seu talento para a CCR.
